//: tsc --checkJs type checking for the plain-JavaScript source (npm run typecheck).
Phase 1 scope: every pure module is checked - engines, catalog, helpers, config, errors,
emulator and firebase.js. src/app.js (and its entry point src/main.js, which imports the
stylesheet) is excluded on purpose: it is the 1600-line file that item 91 splits into modules,
and it gets typed as those modules land.
noImplicitAny stays off until then; every public function is annotated with JSDoc.
